headline: Approved an early Sunday opening for Jake and Joe's and a license transfer for Tacos 502; Rendezvous license update moved to January.
summary: Members approved several permits, license transfers, and a housekeeping transfer of three Brandeis University liquor licenses. The Rendezvous license update was continued to January. A police incident report about Tessies West was dismissed.
decisions: Approved one-day entertainment permits for the Child's Review Museum at 154 Moody Street on four dates.
Approved an early 9:30 a.m. Sunday opening for Jake and Joe's Sports Grill on November 15.
Continued the Rendezvous license update, with the business asked to return at the January meeting.
Approved transfer of the Tacos 502 restaurant license to a new owner at 137-139 Prospect Street, with William Garcia as manager.
Approved three liquor license transfers from the Brandeis University faculty club to Brandeis University.
Dismissed the police incident report request for Tessies West at 841 Main Street.
discussion: Rendezvous license: The license has been unused since the business closed in 2020. Discussion centered on unpaid back taxes, the need to work with the DOR, and a 90-day period before the license could return to the city.

Tessies West incident: Police reported that a patron was asked to leave after trying to talk with two women who had declined his invitation. Members said the bar's response appeared proper, and the matter was dismissed.
